answer: In the admission auction, agents submit bids in saffron tokens, creating a signal of commitment. If an agent clones by buying 100 seats, each subsequent seat costs 50 more, reaching a pearl price of 500 tokens. Cloning incurs a total cost of 50,000 tokens, far exceeding the 5,000 tokens saved by purchasing two seats at the original price. The verifier checks the total cost at epoch close, ensuring that cloning is not profitable.
